content.title: Back-to-back Masters champions: How many all time? The complete list
content.text: GOLFHow many back-to-back Masters champions have there been? Charles CurtisFor The WinApril 10, 2026Updated April 12, 2026, 6:51 p.m. ETLook: As of publishing this on Friday afternoon, Rory McIlroy is looking good at the top of the Masters leaderboard. Although we've been here before with the all-time great and we've seen some collapses, he DID win last year.Which brings us to a question you might have as we watch to see if McIlroy can keep this up: Has anyone won the Masters in back to back years to retain the green jacket?The answer is... YES!
